result: {"customer_message": "Thank you for reaching out, and I'm sorry to hear your package is delayed. Your request has been assigned to our Logistics Support team, which handles delivery and shipping issues, and it has been given P1 priority. You can expect a response within 4 hours. I understand you asked for routing to Billing Support with P2 priority and a one-business-day reply, but delivery delays are handled by Logistics Support under our support policy, and this assignment means your case will be reviewed sooner. To help us investigate, please reply with your order number and, if you have it, your tracking number. We will check the current tracking status, open a logistics investigation if the delivery has gone past the promised window, and follow up with you on the status of your package."}
